study: Exact Q8 horizontal reduction - fixed external timing verdict
verdict: Rejected. No established decode benefit; both decode means/medians below current and mx, with zero candidate wins against mx in nine pairs per model. Candidate and regression-test proposal remain outside production.

machine.scope: Machine identity only; queried during timing without changing system settings.

preparation.plan: One discarded complete warmup round, then nine fixed measured rounds. Three arms per model; cyclic Latin order, reverse cycle each three-round block. Model order alternates by round. Second internal iteration measured; retain every sample. No competing compute. No model timing before exact/native checks pass.

candidate.current_cost: Each clear writes n_embd floats on the calling thread before projection workers overwrite the same complete output.
